definition: a single small ice crystal that falls as snow
description: A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.
